verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe found a live llms.txt (HTTP 200) at apidocs.chargebee.com describing the Chargebee API Reference, so an agent can be pointed straight at it. The doc pages themselves are served as markdown files (for example getting-started.md and usage_events.md), which makes them easy for agents to ingest. The .md.md probe 404 only reflects a doubled extension and does not count against this. Missing for 10: first-party documentation that describes or promotes llms.txt and agent-oriented docs usage, and evidence of a fuller llms-full.txt-style bundle.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
